title.narrative: Bridging Science and Society to Strengthen Evidence-Based Decision-Making in Eastern Africa

description.narrative: This programme aims to strengthen interactions between scientists, policymakers, educators, media, civil society, and local communities to promote evidence-based decision-making and foster a stronger science culture in Eastern Africa. Through science-policy dialogues, science diplomacy initiatives, science communication, and public engagement activities, the programme will enhance the use of scientific knowledge in policymaking and sustainable development planning. It will support mechanisms that facilitate knowledge exchange, improve science literacy, and strengthen partnerships among key stakeholders. By bridging the gap between science and society, the programme will contribute to more informed policies, increased public trust in science, and resilient, sustainable development outcomes.
